messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to prioritize the private deployment work for Q3/Q4. main asks: VPC control plane, on-prem packaging (rpm/docker bundle), and air-gapped installer. customers pushing for timelines. Thoughts?

Jorge (Eng-Platform): +1. From infra POV VPC control plane is highest risk (networking + multi-tenant isolation). packaging is lower risk but still a lot of QA. air-gap adds signing + offline deps.

Priya (Security): We need KMS/HSM integration and attestations for air-gap. compliance customers will treat signing + reproducible build as hard blockers.

Sam (Solutions): Customer A (healthcare) needs air-gapped install and audit logs by Nov. Customer B (finance) can accept VPC-controlled private for Jan. driving asks.

Nina (Sales): FYI — two RFPs pending that mention "air-gapped" explicitly. If we can commit a date we convert pipeline.

Maya (PM): Proposal: split into three milestones with acceptance criteria. quick sketch: 
```
M1 (Q3): On-prem packaging + docs, installer image, CI-signed artifacts, basic KMS integration
M2 (Q4): VPC control plane beta (private control plane + auth), RBAC, routing policies
M3 (Q4->Q1): Air-gapped installer w/ offline dependency bundle, attestation + signed images
```
Acceptance criteria samples per milestone in doc below.

Jorge (Eng-Platform): Feels OK but timeline tight. For M2 we need network egress controls and fallback routing support. Need 6 weeks of perf testing on Dedicated stack.

Alex (SRE): We should add operability SLOs for private installs: deployment time target, upgrade window, and rollback tested. Example SLOs: 99% successful installs within 2 hours; upgrades revert on failure within 30m.

Priya (Security): For air-gap: require reproducible builds + signed SBOM. Also define threat model for offline upgrades. Will need support from build infra to create reproducible images.

Sam (Solutions): Can we surface minimal config templates for customers? I can draft 3 templates: "VPC-lite", "VPC-enterprise", "Air-gapped-basic" to speed onboarding.

Maya (PM): Good. Decision points we need to resolve now: 1) Do we scope M1 to include KMS/HSM or defer to M2? 2) Who owns packaging QA and signing? 3) Target commits for sales RFPs?

Jorge (Eng-Platform): 1) Include basic KMS integration in M1 (pluggable). Full HSM flows in M2. 2) Platform owns packaging, but release engineering needs to own signing pipeline. 3) We can aim to support RFPs by providing M1 delivery dates.

Priya (Security): Agreed on KMS pluggable + HSM in M2. Security will own spec for SBOM and signing keys.

Nina (Sales): If M1 delivery date to customers is mid-Oct we can push two deals. Any chance we can commit to that?

Jorge (Eng-Platform): mid-Oct is ambitious. Realistic: internal beta images by 10/15, external beta by 11/1 after 2 weeks of stability. So target external commit end-Nov.

Maya (PM): Ok we'll mark external/public M1 as "end-Nov" for commitments. Internal alpha mid-Oct. Add these to roadmap doc and OKRs.

Alex (SRE): I'll add operability test matrix to the alpha checklist. Quick snippet: 
```
- install (clean) x3 across supported OS
- upgrade from prior minor release
- backup/restore key material
- smoke e2e with sample prompt set <= 500 tokens
```

Sam (Solutions): I'll produce the templates and a minimal playbook for field engineers by 10/1.

Maya (PM): Next steps: I'll update the roadmap doc and PR the M1/M2/M3 acceptance criteria. @Jorge can you own engineering estimates? @Priya own security spec? @Sam own templates + field playbook?

Jorge (Eng-Platform): on it. I'll drop estimates by EOD Friday with rough team allocation.

Priya (Security): I'll draft the SBOM/signing/HSM spec and threat model by next Tue.

Sam (Solutions): Template drafts incoming 10/1.

Nina (Sales): I'll communicate the mid-Oct internal beta and end-Nov external target to the RFP owners.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: "private-deploy-packaging-v1" (link: https://redwood/rfcs/183).

Maya (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene next Wed to finalize estimates and any scope tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
